blocks.text: Manila, Philippines—The Philippine foreign ministry summoned Beijing’s ambassador to Manila on Monday after he said China would “easily win” a conflict between the countries, with local senators calling for his expulsion. Foreign Secretary Maria Theresa Lazaro expressed to Ambassador Jing Quan the country’s “serious concern and strong objection to his public statement of 15 October 2026, which conveyed a threat of the use of force”, the Department of Foreign Affairs said. “The Department reserves the right to take further diplomatic action as it deems necessary,” it said in a statement, adding that Lazaro told Jing his comments were “provocative and unacceptable”.
